Current regulations make cars run lower in corners, worsening the bumpy conditions.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Drivers raised concerns about severe bumps at the Austin track, with Verstappen reporting extreme vertical loads impacting his spine. Norris agreed that the track is very bumpy and causes headaches, while Russell considered the bumps a normal part of racing.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The track conditions cause physical strain and potential damage to drivers' spines and health. Current car regulations exacerbate the problem by forcing cars to run lower in corners, raising safety and comfort issues.
